why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Clear the Core tasks, then the Daily ones. Most are posts, quotes, searches and bookmarks on X, plus joining the VOICE Discord. Warning Most tasks are promotional posts from your own X account. Bots, multiple accounts and referral farming can cost you your points.
Vote in the open polls. VOICE says every vote, quest and invite counts toward your next tier.

If you hold a pass, press the upgrade button on it each time you reach the next tier's CLOUT and task level. VOICE called the days before the snapshot the "last chance to stack CLOUT and upgrade your Voicy Pass on Social Camp before the snapshot".
